ModMetaData.description:
Adds new memes and structures to Rimworld.
<size=24>Features</size>
- Adds 14 new structures - Adds 23 new memes - Adds 4 new Extreme impact memes - Greatly expands all vanilla Ideology styles (Techist, Morbid, etc) with more than 500 individual styled weapons, buildings, etc
